# Peptide Discount

> Coupon codes and price-per-mg data for 40 research-peptide vendors. Each vendor page lists the code, the discount, what the code covers, and the COA, shipping and delivery details we hold. Products are for laboratory research use only. The site gives no medical or dosing advice. Some links are affiliate links.
